newsitem.title: USA: Image Sensing expects better 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Image Sensing expects better 2nd half.

text.p: Image Sensing Systems Inc president Spiro Voglis said he still expects the second half of 1996 will show improvement over the first half for the company.

"There are a significant number of advanced traffic management projects in the bidding stage that will be using machine vision technology," Voglis said in a statement. "The Autoscope, our cornerstone product, is well positioned to be selected for several of these projects," he added.

Earlier on Friday, Image Sensing posted a third-quarter loss of $0.10 per share compared with a year-earlier loss of $0.03 per share. It cited increased investments in sales marketing and new product development as factors for the decline.
For the nine months, the company lost $0.45 per share on revenues of $2.2 million.
